key_terms.سُرَّةُ الْبَطْحَاءِ: Best part of the valley of al-Baṭha'

ai.seo_question: What are the metaphors used to describe the Prophet's selection and status in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi employs these metaphors to emphasize the Prophet's ontological primacy and divine election, framing him as the culmination of prophetic lineage and the ultimate source of esoteric wisdom. In Shia exegesis, terms like 'Surrat al-Batḥāʾ' (Navel of al-Baṭḥāʾ) often allude to the sacred geography of Mecca and the spiritual axis of the world, reinforcing his role as the light guiding humanity out of darkness.
